headword: {河童|かっぱ}の{川流|かわなが}れ
gloss: even experts make mistakes; even the best slip up

definitions.gloss: even experts make mistakes; even a master can fail; even Homer nods
definitions.explanation: A proverb meaning that even someone highly skilled can occasionally fail at their own specialty. Literally, 'even a kappa gets swept down the river' — the kappa being a water sprite famed as an expert swimmer.

examples.japanese: {河童|かっぱ}の{川流|かわなが}れ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦やつ→やつ：10782_yatsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a case of even the experts slipping up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧な⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溺|おぼ}れ→溺れる：02026_oboreru⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{河童|かっぱ}の{川流|かわなが}れだ。
examples.english: For him, a strong swimmer, to nearly drown — even the best slip up.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{塩加減|しおかげん}→塩加減：08575_shiokagen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{河童|かっぱ}の{川流|かわなが}れだ。
examples.english: For a professional cook to get the seasoning wrong is truly a case of even a master failing.

notes:
A well-known proverb. The ⟦{河童|かっぱ}→河童：06521_kappa⟧ is a legendary water creature said to be an expert swimmer, so for even a kappa to be swept away by the current vividly conveys that anyone, however skilled, can fail at their own forte.

USAGE:
Used to comment on a surprising failure by an expert, often sympathetically. It can also serve as a gentle, self-deprecating excuse for one's own slip.
